speaker: richard_quiney
text: I'll sit on the bed's foot. You need not get up, and I can see you are not going to. Half a visit is better than a visit you have to walk me out of.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The floor is the visit. Say the thing, Richard. I cannot leave it.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: The brief. The town's, not mine. The bailiff will have it fair-copied again before the week is out, and he wants a hand that London will not laugh at. I told him yours was on a floor, and he said floors have held worse petitions.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I can hear a petition. I cannot chase one down a stair. If it wants a phrase mended, mend it here, in one sentence, and take the sentence away with you.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: One sentence, then. The fires were two, and the loss is the town's living, which is malt, and the brief says so without calling the fire a judgment. The preachers are doing that for nothing. We need not pay them in prose.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Strike judgment. Leave the malt. That is the sentence.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: I'll take it. The two gentlemen who are to certify the losses are already set. I am not going to name them over a man on a floor, and you are not going to ask.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: There is the other matter, and it is not money. A word from a great lord's servant might do what a second letter from a bailiff will not. If such a word were offered, the town would know what to do with it. I am not asking you to write to a lord. I am asking you whether a player ever hears a servant speak plainly.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Players hear servants. Servants do not hear players, unless the servant was sent to hear. I have no such errand. If a word comes, it will not come because I lay on a floor in Henley Street and wished it.

speaker: richard_quiney
text: Then I have asked, and you have not promised, and the brief has its sentence. I'll go before I think of a third thing.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Go before the third thing. I am poor company for a man who can stand.
